text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
About the "Summer Training Camp"――
It starts in July!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: To brush things up, we decided to set the stage on Tracen Island this year!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "That being said... this island doesn't have any facilities to accommodate large groups yet."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but please keep our base at the
usual "Summer Training Camp Lodgings"!
Conduct training only on Tracen Island!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: It's such a great training facility that you'll completely forget the hassle of traveling here!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
You'll be able to train even harder than usual!
Look forward to the summer, alright~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it starts in the first half of July, two turns from now.
Keep an eye on your energy and get ready for the training camp!
